purpose: Teach: たちまち/因みに/御覧/益々/まわる/向う/ちび/ちょいと

lines.speaker: mei_romantic
lines.jp: 葵、お客様がいらっしゃるとたちまちお店が華やぐね、メイちゃん
lines.en: Aoi, the shop just comes alive when customers walk in, doesn't it?
lines.style: Warm observation, soft smile in the voice. Genuine appreciation without fussiness. Light, unhurried pace. The tone of someone noticing something small and lovely.

lines.speaker: aoi_barista
lines.jp: 葵、因みに新メニューの試食はいつにする?メイちゃん
lines.en: Aoi, by the way — when should we do the tasting for the new menu?
lines.style: Practical, forward-looking. Quick, efficient rhythm. Curious energy without pressure. The ease of planning with someone you work well with.

lines.speaker: mei_romantic
lines.jp: 葵、「御覧の通り」って看板を出してお勧めしよう、メイちゃん
lines.en: Aoi, let's put out a sign — 'as you can see' — and recommend it that way.
lines.style: Gentle suggestion, collaborative. Slight rise on the idea itself. Thoughtful pacing. The tone of offering an idea while leaving room for agreement.

lines.speaker: aoi_barista
lines.jp: 葵、お客様が益々増えてるね、メイちゃん
lines.en: Aoi, we're getting more and more customers lately, aren't we?
lines.style: Pleased observation, light wonder underneath. Warm, steady tone. Slight upward lift on the phrase itself, almost disbelieving in a good way.

lines.speaker: mei_romantic
lines.jp: 葵、コーヒー豆をまわるように混ぜようね、メイちゃん
lines.en: Aoi, let's stir the coffee beans in a circular motion, hmm?
lines.style: Gentle instruction, collaborative not commanding. Soft emphasis on the method. Patient, almost meditative pace. The voice of someone teaching while doing it alongside.

lines.speaker: aoi_barista
lines.jp: 葵、お客様、向うの席の方が静かだって、メイちゃん
lines.en: Aoi, some of the customers say the seats over there are quieter.
lines.style: Quiet observation, noticing detail. Conversational, matter-of-fact. Slight hesitation — offering information, not pushing. The tone of someone who actually listens to what people say.

lines.speaker: mei_romantic
lines.jp: 葵、ちびっ子のお客様にもサービスしようね、メイちゃん
lines.en: Aoi, let's make sure to take care of the little customers too, okay?
lines.style: Tender direction, inclusive. Warm emphasis on 'little'. Unhurried, gentle pacing. The voice of someone whose kindness extends to the smallest person in the room.

lines.speaker: aoi_barista
lines.jp: 葵、ちょいとお店の前を掃除してくるね、メイちゃん
lines.en: Aoi, I'm going to sweep the front for a bit.
lines.style: Light, purposeful announcement. Quick, efficient rhythm. The casual ease of handling a small task. Slight upbeat energy — something to do, done willingly.
